podcast.title: Dislike of Organ Sound
podcast.body: Eric Burden expressed a personal dislike for the sound of the Vox organ that Alan Price used, despite it becoming a signature element of The Animals' sound. "burdened dislike the sound of the organ, even though it became one of the defining sounds of the group."

podcast.title: Early Jazz Fanatic
podcast.body: As a teenager in Newcastle, Eric Burden was a jazz fanatic who met John Steele at art school, leading to their formation of a trad jazz band. "Steel and burden, when they met at art school, were both jazz fanatics, and they quickly formed a trad jazz band."

podcast.title: R&B and Blues Preferences
podcast.body: Burden's musical tastes leaned heavily towards the jazziest side of R&B, with Ray Charles, Jimmy Witherspoon, and Big Joe Turner being particular favorites whom he tried to emulate. "bands taste at the time were oriented towards the jazziest side of R&B, people like Ray Charles, and he also particularly loved blues shelters like Jimmy with a spoon and Big Joe Turner."

podcast.title: Shift to Lead Vocalist
podcast.body: With the band's transition from trad jazz to rock and roll/skiffle, Eric Burden ceased playing an instrument and assumed the role of lead singer. "burden stopped playing an instrument and became the lead singer."
